rules_ds:
from math import ln

schema T scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    z: Float mutable
    one: Float mutable
    two: Float mutable
    three: Float mutable
    half: Float mutable
    big: Float mutable

rule ln_pos_zero_is_neg_inf:
    T t where ln(t.z) is -inf
->
    log info "a"

rule ln_neg_zero_is_neg_inf:
    T t where ln(-t.z) is -inf
->
    log info "b"

rule ln_one_is_pos_zero:
    T t where (ln(t.one) == 0.0) and ((1.0 / ln(t.one)) is inf)
->
    log info "c"

rule ln_pos_inf_is_pos_inf:
    T t where ln(t.big * t.big) is inf
->
    log info "d"

rule ln_negative_is_nan:
    T t where ln(-t.one) is NaN
->
    log info "e"

rule ln_neg_inf_is_nan:
    T t where ln(-(t.big * t.big)) is NaN
->
    log info "f"

rule ln_two_is_finite:
    T t where ln(t.two) == 0.6931471805599453
->
    log info "g"
